name: @iseoane/agent-depot
description: A cross-platform catalog for reusable coding-agent skills.
author: iseoane

scripts.test:single: pnpm build && node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const input = process.argv[1] || 'tests/version.test.ts'; const file = input.replace(/^tests[\\/]/, 'dist/tests/').replace(/\\.ts$/i, '.js'); process.exit(spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', file], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status ?? 1);"
scripts.test:coverage: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('coverage',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.coverage.json && node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); process.exit(spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--enable-source-maps','--test','--test-reporter=dot','dist/tests/*.test.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, NODE_V8_COVERAGE: 'coverage/v8' } }).status ?? 1);"
scripts.audit:health: pnpm test:coverage && npx --yes fallow@3.30.0 health --coverage coverage/v8 --min-score 85
scripts.audit:all: pnpm audit:dead-code && pnpm audit:dupes && pnpm audit:health
